rule_set.description: Manning rules reverse-engineered from 'Targets & Haulage Priorities' rows 47 and 65-116. Expressions use a tiny language: numbers, 'strings', + - * /, comparisons (> >= < <= == !=), parentheses, max(a,b), min(a,b), identifiers (params.*, inputs.*, circuit.*, totals.*, roles.*). Rules run in array order; 'add' accumulates role counts, 'set' assigns.

circuit_kinds.excavator: Truck-loading excavator circuit producing waste (EX09, EX04, EX06)

roles.excavator_operator: Prime-mover excavator operator for an active EX circuit
roles.dozer_floor_dump: Dozer operators supporting an EX circuit: 1 floor/clean-up + 1 dump
roles.dozer_coal: Coal dozer operator supporting a loader circuit
roles.support_excavator_operator: EX03/EX08 support excavator operator for the coal loader circuit
roles.dozer_push_assist: 'EX06 DZR Assist' operator (manned whenever bulk push dozers > 0)
roles.dozer_enabling: Dozers taken off push for enabling tasks (e.g. DR Prep)

rules.text: Every truck allocated to a circuit needs one truck operator.
IF an excavator circuit has trucks > 0 THEN +1 excavator operator.
IF an excavator circuit has trucks > 0 THEN +2 dozer operators (1 floor + 1 dump).
IF a coal loader circuit has trucks > 0 THEN +1 loader operator.
IF a coal loader circuit has trucks > 0 THEN +1 coal dozer operator.
IF coal loader LDR 1 has trucks > 0 THEN +1 support excavator operator (EX03/EX08).
rules.compat_note: Spreadsheet keys this to LDR 1 only; LDR 2 alone gets no support EX. Proposed improved rule: where circuit.kind=='loader', at most one support EX in total (cap via a 'max_per_plan': 1).

rules.text: Bulk push dozers = 7 push dozers - dozers on enabling tasks - one dozer for every truck above 12 (dozer operators re-deployed to drive trucks).
rules.compat_note: No clamp at 0 in the spreadsheet (can go negative when trucks > 18 with 1 enabling dozer).

rules.text: IF bulk push dozers > 0 THEN +1 'EX06 DZR Assist' operator.
rules.compat_note: Label is ambiguous (EX06 assisting the push vs a dozer assisting EX06). If EX06 also runs a truck circuit, its operator is counted again by R2.

rules.text: Each dozer assigned to enabling tasks needs an operator.
Fixed daily manning: 2 water cart, 2 grader, 3 supervisors/OCE.
